hero.title: Pick a game, and let the nest begin
hero.subtitle: One television in the middle, phones around it. Choose a shelf, read the rules, then open the room.

browse.title: Party games
browse.soon: Games for this shelf are on the way.
browse.locked: This game is for Nest Premium members.

how.title: How it plays
how.1t: Open the room on the TV
how.1d: The code and QR stay put. Players join and wait for the game.
how.2d: Each player types a name. Fourteen is the ceiling.
how.3t: The round stays on the big screen
how.3d: Answers come from the phone. Scores are counted on the server.

premiumSub: Free is enough to try. Premium opens every game and lifts the daily room limit.
footer: The Nest — living-room games, in the browser.

admin.guide: Change the site name in Settings under brand. Prices live on Plans. Card payment starts after the host has STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, MOYASAR_SECRET_KEY, or TAP_SECRET_KEY. A custom domain is attached from publish settings.
